assets.prompt: Use case: compositing. Produce one polished landscape 3:2 branding-agency comparison board from these five reference packaging photographs. Put a small plain dark name caption below each photo, verbatim "Dayable", "Soluen", "DearTempo", "Good Measure", "Ordelan". In the sixth panel, exact text only: "Five names." then "Five ways to feel." then smaller "The same foot-stimulation wrap concept." White or very pale warm paper background, generous clean gutters and margins, no overprinted title obscuring boxes, no decorative collage, no arrows, no badges, no pricing, no additional claims or text, no watermark.
